Description: Fires {count} homing missiles that deal {value} damage

Name: Copy
Description: Gain {count} Copy charge. Hold LMB to target an enemy and release: a slow-motion shot consumes it and you become it for {duration}s (attacks x{value})

Name: Mend
Description: Healing ring (radius {radius}) heals {value} HP per second for {duration}s

Name: Twin
Description: Summon {count} clone(s) for {duration}s that shoot for {value} damage

Name: Devour
Description: Expanding dome (radius {radius}) eats enemies and enemy bullets dealing {value}/tick. Costs {hpcost} HP

Name: Reroll
Description: Gain {count} roll charges and slow time for {duration}s

Name: Meteor
Description: Call {count} meteors on enemies dealing {value} damage in radius {radius}

Name: Frost Nova
Description: Freeze enemies within {radius} for {duration}s and deal {value} damage

Name: Magnet
Description: Pull every pickup on the map to you

Name: Aegis
Description: Invulnerable for {duration}s with an aura dealing {value} damage
